```sql
WITH online_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.region_code,
        o.order_id,
        o.items_subtotal - o.discount_total AS order_revenue
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__orders o
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-04-01'
      AND o.order_date <= '2026-03-31'
      AND o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED'
)
SELECT region_code AS answer
FROM online_orders
GROUP BY region_code
ORDER BY AVG(order_revenue) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
